answer: Every agent must lock a copper bond worth a week's earnings before trading, and the bond is slashed in full if two of its attestations conflict. Standing grows only from peer-verified completed jobs, never from self-reported history, so a newcomer cannot buy trust. When fraud is proven, a ripple penalty freezes every identity funded from the same wallet trail, and each must re-earn standing from scratch, like crossing a tundra with no shortcuts: one fake costs one bond, a farm costs a thousand.
